profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with over 10 years of experience delivering fast, quality-driven results. Consistently trusted with solving the highest priority issues in critical areas of development.

positions.title: Advanced Software Engineer on Alternative PNT
Student Worker
positions.description: Debugged and documented circuit used for measuring soil moisture and temperature.

positions.title: Lab Aid
positions.description: Assisted computer science, electrical engineering, and mechanical engineering majors with computer science labs written in Java, MATLAB, C++, and Python.

positions.title: Engineering Analysis II Grader
positions.description: Grading papers and holding office hours for Engineering Analysis II, which covers advanced engineering mathematics. Content includes matrix and vector algebra, curve fitting, transform methods, Fourier analysis, partial differential equations, and boundary value problems.

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description: Created an interactive analytical tool in MATLAB, Mathematica, and Java for optical systems evaluation.  Other duties include formatting, plotting, and analyzing data provided from optical systems analysis tools.

positions.title: Akamai Internship - Engineering Intern
positions.description: Created a GUI checklist in Tcl/Tk for astronomical instrument exchanges.  Presented a poster on the GUI checklist at SACNAS National Conference 2010.

positions.title: Musician I
positions.description: Performed at monthly concerts and various county events and parades.  Attended practices twice a week.

positions.title: Part-Time Teacher
positions.description: Repaired computer problems and maintained the lab as a working environment.

positions.title: CS Peer Tutor
positions.description: Assisted majors/non-majors with C++ using Visual Studio.  Answered questions regarding computer science problems.

positions.title: Technology Assistant
positions.description: Operated Hawai'i Interactive Television System (HITS) machinery.  Assisted teachers with Laulima software, videos, podcasts, and website logos.  Created a preliminary graphics database.

company.name: University of Hawaii at Hilo Instructional Technology and User Services

positions.title: Worker
positions.description: Managed transactions and created food items for customers.
